summary: Tiptree Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 2.01) reporting the completion of the sale of all membership interests of Reliance First Capital LLC to Carrington Mortgage Services, LLC. The sale closed May 1, 2026, for a cash purchase price of $47,291,890 at closing, with up to an additional $2,000,000 held in escrow for purchase price adjustment and $1,027,798 held for tax-related holdback, both subject to final determination. Tiptree acted as seller through wholly owned subsidiaries; no board recommendation or advisors are named. The deal was initially agreed October 31, 2025, and amended December 5, 2025. Watch for release of escrows and potential post-closing adjustments.
